metadata.counting_rule: Only newly authored AoA quests count toward the target. Existing imported quest content is excluded.

architecture_policy.boss_unlock_rule: Each age has one dedicated boss chapter with sequential boss kills unlocking required branch packages. Required branch completion unlocks the age main boss, and defeating that main boss moves progression into the next major phase.
